gloss: to skip reading; to skim over

definitions.gloss: to skip reading; to skim over
definitions.explanation: To intentionally skip parts of a text while reading, either because it seems unimportant or to save time.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しい{部分|ぶぶん}は{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばした。
examples.english: I skipped over the difficult parts.

examples.japanese: {説明書|せつめいしょ}の{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}を{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばさないでください。
examples.english: Please don't skip the precautions in the manual.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}がなくて、{途中|とちゅう}を{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばして{最後|さいご}だけ{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I didn't have time, so I skipped the middle and just read the ending.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす → {読|よ}み{飛|と}ばさない (negative)
・{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす → {読|よ}み{飛|と}ばして (te-form)
・{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす → {読|よ}み{飛|と}ばした (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {読|よ}む (to read) + {飛|と}ばす (to skip, to jump over)

USAGE:
・{広告|こうこく}を{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす (to skip ads)
・{長文|ちょうぶん}を{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす (to skim long texts)
・{退屈|たいくつ}な{章|しょう}を{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす (to skip boring chapters)

The ～{飛|と}ばす pattern indicates skipping or jumping over something.
